paper.tldr: It is shown that univariate multiplicity codes of rate R over fields of prime order can be list-decoded from a (1 R e) fraction of errors in polynomial time (for constant R;e).

paper.title: Decoding of Reed Solomon Codes beyond the Error-Correction Bound
paper.tldr: To the best of the knowledge, this is the first efficient (i.e., polynomial time bounded) algorithm which provides error recovery capability beyond the error-correction bound of a code for any efficient code.

paper.title: Gaussian Grouping: Segment and Edit Anything in 3D Scenes
paper.tldr: Based on Gaussian Grouping, a local Gaussian Editing scheme is proposed, which shows efficacy in versatile scene editing applications, including 3D object removal, inpainting, colorization, style transfer and scene recomposition.

paper.title: OpenGaussian: Towards Point-Level 3D Gaussian-based Open Vocabulary Understanding
paper.tldr: This paper introduces OpenGaussian, a method based on 3D Gaussian Splatting capable of 3D point-level open vocabulary understanding and introduces an instance-level 3D-2D feature association method that links 3D points to 2D masks, which is further associated with 2D CLIP features.

paper.title: Emerging Properties in Self-Supervised Vision Transformers
paper.venue: IEEE International Conference on Computer Vision
paper.tldr: This paper questions if self-supervised learning provides new properties to Vision Transformer (ViT) that stand out compared to convolutional networks (convnets) and implements DINO, a form of self-distillation with no labels, which implements the synergy between DINO and ViTs.
